title: A Guide to Google Ads for Restaurant Owners in 2025

facts.fact: The article was first published on February 18, 2025.
The article was last updated on March 14, 2025.
The page states a reading time of 4 minutes.
The author recommends that small restaurants start Google Ads spend at £5–£10 per day; the page calls this a very rough guide.
The author suggests mid-sized restaurants spend £20–£50 per day in higher competition areas.
facts.quote: £20–£50 per day for higher competition areas.

facts.fact: The author suggests large restaurants or chains spend £100+ per day for aggressive marketing.
The page states Google Ads uses a pay-per-click (PPC) model in which advertisers pay only when someone clicks the ad.
facts.quote: Google Ads works on a pay-per-click (PPC) model, meaning you only pay when someone clicks on your ad.

facts.fact: The page defines Performance Max as a campaign type that automatically shows ads across Google Search, Maps, YouTube, and Gmail.
facts.quote: A campaign type that automatically shows your ads across multiple platforms, including Google Search, Maps, YouTube, and Gmail.
